title: Focus
description: A justified lyric block where every line sits at its own distance from the lens. Turn the ribbed focus ring (0.5 m to infinity) and focus racks down the lines: the rest melt into real disc blur, and the sharp line lights up with red focus-peaking edges.
intent: Depth of field as typography: each line is a layer at a set distance, blurred by a mip-prefiltered disc kernel sized from the diopter gap to the focus ring, with focus peaking drawn only where the text is genuinely sharp.
sources: herb reference board: ee6eda60 and 0fc59ca9 justified, softened lyric blocks
